newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD EXPECTED SOON ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD EXPECTED SOON ON BOURSE.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Friday, that Riga Shipyard can be expected to be listed on the bourse soon after next week's public offer for cash.
Some 8.37 percent of the shipyard's shares or 837,140 shares with a minimum value of 1.30 lats will be auctioned on April 14.

However, the privatisation agency said that there were several risk factors linked to the company, including claims that former land owners have against it and a lack of co-operation from the management in providing information.
"Riga Shipyard will very soon appear on either of the two bourse's lists after the public offer for cash is completed," Uldis Cerps, stock exchange president, told a news conference.
The company has posted a 1.05 million lat profit on turnover of 6.48 million during nine months of 1996 versus 887,000 lats in the same period of the previous year.
It registered after-tax profit of 1.116 million in 1995.

A controlling stake in the company or 4.37 million shares is held by Remar-Riga, co-owned by the employees and the stock company Baltijas Holdings, which have 32 percent and 43.7 percent respectively.
The bourse also said that once the company is listed it will have to compy with all the rules on releasing information.
